body.title: The BUILD approval check
body.summary: Add checkBuildEpicImpact (a pure read in the workflow layer: the BUILD summary's 'Epic impact:' paragraph, the minimum length constant, each id in the LLD's epicImpact.storiesCovered as a whole token inside it; not applicable for a Story with no approved LLD, no epicImpact or applies:false; unreadable records make it not apply and are logged) and call it from approveOne in approveWorkflowTarget (src/workflow/gates.ts) after the log-conflict refusal and the roll-up retry shortcut and before approveArtifactByJsonPath, skipped when req.overrideReview is set; a refusal is a skipped[] entry with the reason and the new kind 'epic-impact-missing' (added to the kind union and set only when req.skipKinds is true). Refresh inventory fixtures only for what this task changes. Tests in epic-impact-build-check.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: checkBuildEpicImpact does not apply to a Story with no approved LLD, whose LLD has no epicImpact or whose epicImpact says it does not apply, and for a later Story refuses a summary with no 'Epic impact:' paragraph, one under the minimum length, or one that does not name each covered Story as a whole token inside that paragraph, passes one that does, and never throws on an unreadable record

approveWorkflowTarget over a later Story's BUILD without the paragraph returns it in skipped[] with the reason and the kind 'epic-impact-missing' (when skipKinds is set) and creates no record, approves it with an explicit overrideReview, approves one with the paragraph, and leaves a first Story's BUILD, a standalone Story's BUILD whose LLD carries an applies:true analysis checked the same way, a test record, a BUILD awaiting a roll-up retry and every existing refusal as they were
the existing approval tests still pass and no inventory test case fails beyond the four that already fail on a clean checkout

tests.name: epic-impact-build-check.test.ts: checkBuildEpicImpact does not apply to a Story with no approved LLD, whose LLD has no epicImpact or whose epicImpact says it does not apply, and for a later Story refuses a BUILD summary with no 'Epic impact:' paragraph, one that is under the minimum length, or one that does not name each Story the LLD's analysis covered as a whole token inside that paragraph, and passes one that does, and never throws on an unreadable record

epic-impact-build-check.test.ts: approveWorkflowTarget over a later Story's BUILD without the paragraph returns it in skipped[] with the reason and the kind 'epic-impact-missing' (when skipKinds is set) and creates no record, approves it with an explicit overrideReview, approves one with the paragraph, and leaves a first Story's BUILD, a test record and every existing refusal as they were
